scope: A new dated living research report; prior manuscripts and review receipts remain historical and unchanged.
primaryEvidence: Twenty independently published original-publisher audio responses represented by unverified automatic transcripts: nineteen Bashar-related publisher contexts and one Athina/Ashtar creator episode. These are not twenty independent mediums or verified attributed speakers.
separateComparisonEvidence: Fifteen Daniel Scranton authored RSS items plus one Paul Selig publisher-issued spiritual-Guides transcript; modality/author/context confounded, no biological-ET recoding.
citationPolicy: Reuse only the existing verified bibliography and source-reading registers. No fresh literature retrieval, unsupported citation or transferred validation claim.
figurePolicy: Only executed, source-bound figures. Captions state unit, cohort, construction, normalization and material limitation. Normalized NMF weights are not fractions of speech time.

reviewProtocol.task: Review the first complete implemented manuscript against actual data, calculations and source-linked interpretations; record criticisms before corrections.
Review the corrected manuscript and inspect unresolved sensitivity, denominator, novelty and qualitative-source limitations; implement concrete corrections.
Inspect definitive PDF/source ZIP, final source hashes, figures, all-page rendering and reproducibility; bind review to final bytes.

reviewMeaning: Model-agent critical review and reproducibility checking, not independent human peer review.
venueCompliance: TBD; official AAAI/ICWSM preprint style is a writing reference, not a submission claim.
